limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: only the Q18 IP control arm (Q18IPcontrols.zip, 9 RAW) is annotated. 204 of 213 RAW files are left out and logged in annotations/BLOCKED.md: total proteome (72 RAW, L/M/H = Q18/Q64/Q150 order unknown), HttEx1SOL soluble IPs 24 h/48 h (36 RAW, L/M/H order unknown, the only Htt peptide is shared by all polyQ variants so Q64 vs Q150 cannot be anchored), insoluble inclusions (96 RAW; compared conditions and forward/reverse orientation undocumented; 34 deposited RAW names (HttQ105_formicacid, Q103agg_gel, TX_Rep2/Rep3 variants) do not match the names in the deposited search, which call them Q150).

Paper (Kim et al. Mol Cell 2016) not retrievable: no PMC copy, publisher PDF/HTML behind a 403 bot check (not bypassed), Elsevier API needs a key. All sample information comes from the PRIDE protocol, MaxQuant outputs, RAW headers and Cellosaurus.

Label orientation of the annotated arm is derived from bait enrichment (EGFP H/L 14-41 in all three experiments) plus the PRIDE statement that uninduced cells were the background control; no source states "heavy = Q18" in words.

Induction method/agent, induction duration and differentiation protocol for the control IPs are unstated (the PRIDE protocol mentions differentiated cells induced for 24 or 48 h only for the HttEx1SOL IPs); no sampling time or differentiation column is written.
